# A quieter way to read

Good tools get out of the way. Open a document, find what matters, and get back to your day.

## Made for the everyday

Folio keeps your documents **on your device**. This reading view supports *emphasis*, ~~strikethrough~~, and a comfortable line length.

> “Simplicity boils down to two steps: identify the essential. Eliminate the rest.”

### A small checklist

- [x] Open a local document
- [x] Find a useful passage
- [ ] Make a cup of coffee

| Format | Best for |
| --- | --- |
| Markdown | Notes and documentation |
| PDF | Finished documents |
| CSV | A quick look at data |

```sh
folio ~/Documents/notes.md
```

Read more at [Example](https://example.com). Links open only when you choose them.
